specialAbilities.name: Undead
specialAbilities.description: Silent before attacking. Immune to biological effects (e.g. disease, poison) and mind-affecting spells (e.g. Vapours of Dream, Paralysation, Dominate).

specialAbilities.name: Immunities
specialAbilities.description: Only harmed by silver weapons, magic, or magic weapons. Unharmed by cold-based attacks.

specialAbilities.name: Incorporeal
specialAbilities.description: Can pass through walls, doors, and other solid objects.

specialAbilities.name: If killed
specialAbilities.description: Before evaporating into mist and vanishing forever, the banshee curses her slayer to meet their doom. Unless the curse is removed, the character automatically fails their next Saving Throw against a deadly effect (e.g. death, petrification, poison, etc.).
